comment: Every skip the suite is allowed to take, with the reason. A skip whose node id is not covered here fails the build (tests/conftest.py). Prefer resolving a skip over listing it.

allowed.reason: Optional live path: the module runs only when ARACHNE_LIVE_OLLAMA=1 and a local Ollama is listening, so the suite never depends on a model being installed (the honest form of 'test it if it is there').
Needs a node binary on PATH to execute the generated TypeScript client; the skip itself is asserted by test_the_typescript_test_skips_cleanly_when_node_is_absent.

Needs a node binary on PATH to execute the shipped static/workspace.js — the keyboard model itself, not a copy of it — and to time the scripted 20-finding triage. The skip is asserted by test_the_script_test_skips_cleanly_when_node_is_absent.

HTTP/3 is an optional extra (arachne[quic], REQ-DET-006) and this module drives a real QUIC fixture, so it needs aioquic installed. The graceful-degradation half — the check recording the extra's absence as an observation and sending nothing over QUIC — is covered unconditionally by tests/unit/test_http3_probe.py, which is why the absence of this file's tests weakens nothing.
